name: bdd-skills
description: 繁體中文 BDD 情境撰寫與本機實測技能

interface.shortDescription: 撰寫 BDD 情境並執行本機驗證
interface.longDescription: 將功能異動整理成繁體中文 Gherkin 情境，執行本機驗證並產出報告。
interface.defaultPrompt: Use bdd-local-test to write Traditional Chinese BDD scenarios and verify them locally. Review the final candidate diff before testing. Assign subagents to verify the core changes and their prerequisites first, then the remaining acceptance criteria for the specified issue. For an authorized issue update, review the results and obtain the required consistency review before a dedicated subagent posts the reply and evidence and reads them back. 階段與最終回寫逐條交代核准範圍內各驗收條件及子條件的實測結果，呈現方式依 issue-writing skill 的驗證完成模板。每次回寫後，由獨立審核者依 bdd-issue-reply-audit 核對已刊登註記的範圍、證據與版面。 Correct findings, read the updated issue back and repeat the audit. Assign outstanding regression tests after the interim reply passes. Once all BDD checks pass, compare the tested and delivery revisions and confirm Code Review coverage. Reuse the review for the same diff. Review new or uncovered changes and retest based on their impact. Obtain PR or release approval under the project rules. For an undecided development branch, complete the audited interim update and affected regression tests first. Once the applicable published reply passes its audit, the current verification phase is complete and its resources are released, stop and verify the worktree services. Ask about branch delivery only if a choice is still needed. Honor report-only and no-update requests. Change issue status only with separate authorization.
